title: Starbase Tour with Elon Musk [PART 2 // Summer 2021]
summary: Everyday Astronaut takes a tour of SpaceX's Starbase with Elon Musk as guide. Topics include the Raptor engines, launch escape systems, the heat shield and the first orbital test.
why: HN recommends it to see how Musk actually talks and thinks about engineering, unedited and in depth.
